title: ChipBlocks trusted publishers
description: Local pin list at ~/.chipblocks/trusted-publishers.json. Version 1. No keys ship with the app. A key listed here is one the user chose to trust on this computer — not a certificate authority. The runtime parser (content-pack-signature.ts parseTrustedPublishers) is strict in the same direction: unknown fields, a non-array keys list, a key that is not 32 raw ed25519 bytes, or a repeated key refuses the whole file. Refused files are treated as no trusted keys and are not overwritten.

publicKey.description: 32 raw ed25519 bytes as hex or base64/base64url. The runtime stores lowercase hex.
